SELECT 
  s3.SEX,
  AVG(s3.avg_pt),
  AVG(s3.avg_iga_minus_igm),
  AVG(s3.ratio)
FROM (
  SELECT 
    s1.ID,
    s1.SEX,
    s1.avg_pt,
    s1.avg_iga_minus_igm,
    s1.avg_iga_minus_igm / s2.overall_avg_iga_minus_igm as ratio
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      l.ID,
      p.SEX,
      AVG(l.PT) as avg_pt,
      AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) as avg_iga_minus_igm
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX
  ) s1,
  (
    SELECT 
      AVG(avg_iga_minus_igm) as overall_avg_iga_minus_igm
    FROM (
      SELECT 
        AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) as avg_iga_minus_igm
      FROM Laboratory l
      JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
      GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX
    )
  ) s2
  WHERE s2.overall_avg_iga_minus_igm IS NOT NULL
) s3
WHERE s3.SEX != ''
GROUP BY s3.SEX
